title: Supplementary Table S1. Overall characteristics of the institutional dataset and distribution across IRIS structural risk categories.
description: Panel A summarizes the full institution-level dataset. Panel B presents counts, percentages, IRIS Overall scores, and scientific output across the four IRIS structural risk categories.
notes: 1. IRIS Overall score and structural risk category are reported as supplied by SCImago IRIS. | 2. Percentages use all 5,475 institutions as the denominator. | 3. Scientific output is the institutional output variable supplied by SCImago IRIS.
